title: Carathéodory Conjecture
exact_target: Must the two principal curvatures agree at two or more points on every twice continuously differentiable closed convex surface in three-dimensional Euclidean space?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1373 (GEOM-014). CC BY 4.0.
Mohammad Ghomi and Ralph Howard, \emph{Normal curvatures of asymptotically constant graphs and Carathéodory's conjecture} (2011), arXiv:1101.3031v2, Section 1 and Theorem 1.1.
